announcements.headline: Ipsos: Disclosure of trading in own shares under a share buyback programme (9 to 13 november 2026)
announcements.insight: Ipsos discloses routine share buyback trading for the week ending 13 November 2026. This follows a previous disclosure in early November and coincides with recent executive appointments.

announcements.headline: Ipsos announced that it filed a complaint on Wednesday, 11 November regarding a breach on one of its internal information systems
announcements.insight: A breach of an internal information system has been reported. This follows recent executive appointments and share buyback activity.

announcements.headline: Ipsos: Disclosure of trading in own shares under a share buyback programme (2 to 6 november 2026)
announcements.insight: Ipsos discloses routine trading in its own shares for early November. This follows recent leadership changes and a Q3 update.

announcements.headline: Ipsos appoints Mitch Barns as Chairman and CEO, Americas
announcements.insight: Mitch Barns replaces Kelly Beaver as CEO. This follows Beaver's appointment in July and acceleration of the Horizons plan in September.

announcements.headline: Ipsos: Organic growth of 2.0% in Q3
announcements.insight: Organic growth of 2.0% in Q3 follows Kelly Beaver's appointment as CEO in July and her acceleration of the Horizons strategic plan in September.

announcements.headline: The Human Advantage Conference 2026: Navigating a complex world through Behavioural Science, AI and Human Intelligence
announcements.insight: Kelly Beaver accelerates the Horizons strategic plan. This conference highlights behavioural science and AI as key themes for navigating complexity.

announcements.headline: Ipsos: Kelly Beaver accelerates the execution of the Horizons strategic plan
announcements.insight: Kelly Beaver accelerates the Horizons strategic plan following her July appointment as CEO. This marks a shift in execution pace under new leadership.

announcements.headline: Kelly Beaver appointed Chief Executive Officer of Ipsos
announcements.insight: Kelly Beaver is appointed CEO. This follows the May Advisory Board creation and June CCO appointment, indicating a leadership restructuring.

announcements.headline: Ipsos: Marion Beyret appointed Chief Communications Officer of Ipsos
announcements.insight: Marion Beyret is appointed Chief Communications Officer. This follows the May Advisory Board creation, indicating ongoing governance adjustments.

announcements.headline: Ipsos announces the creation of an Advisory Board chaired by Eileen Campbell
announcements.insight: Ipsos SA has established an Advisory Board chaired by Eileen Campbell. This board change may influence governance and strategic oversight for shareholders.
